select FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID feeId, FFCR.BASE_RULE floatBaseRule, FFCR.AST_VDATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, FFCRU.F_ACCR_DATE provisionFirstDay, NVL(FFCR.BASE_TYPE,MF.BASIC_BILL) basicBill, MF.BASIS basis, FFCRU.ACCR_TYPE accrType, FFCRU.INTERVAL_RULE interValRule, FFCRU.F_ACCR_END_DATE fAccrEndDate, FFCRU.ACCR_TDAY_RULE accrTdayRule, FFCRU.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FIN_CASH_INFO.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate, FIN_CASH_INFO.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, FIN_CASH_INFO.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, FIN_CASH_INFO.PAY_CYCLE payCycle from (SELECT FCI.CASH_ID, FCI.FINPROD_ID, FCI.FEE_ID, FCPR.FIRST_PAY_DATE, FCPR.END_TDAY_RULE, FCPR.PAY_TDAY_RULE, FCPR.PAY_CYCLE, FCPR.EFF_DATE FROM FIN_CASH_INFO FCI JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR ON FCI.CASH_ID = FCPR.CASH_ID JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FP1 ON FCI.FINPROD_ID = FP1.FINPROD_ID JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD FPA ON FCI.FINPROD_ID = FPA.FINPROD_ID WHERE FCI.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} AND FCI.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2} AND ((FCI.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FPA.DEAL_MODE != #{dealMode10}) OR (FP1.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and FPA.DEAL_MODE = #{dealMode10} AND FPA.TERM_TYPE != #{termType02})) AND FCI.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}) FIN_CASH_INFO , FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE FFCR, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE FFCRU, MST_FEEINFO MF, FIN_PRODUCT FP where FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FFCR.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.EFF_DATE = FFCR.EFF_DATE and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FFCRU.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.EFF_DATE = FFCRU.EFF_DATE and FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MF.FEE_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID
and FFCR.EFF_DATE = to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and FFCRU.EFF_DATE = to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and (FFCR.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE AND FFCRU.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE OR FP.FINPROD_TYPE2= #{finprodType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

select FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID feeId, FFCR.EFF_DATE effDate, FFCR.BASE_RULE floatBaseRule, FFCR.AST_VDATE_TYPE netAssetValueDay, FFCRU.F_ACCR_DATE provisionFirstDay, NVL(FFCR.BASE_TYPE,MF.BASIC_BILL) basicBill, MF.BASIS basis, FFCRU.ACCR_TYPE accrType, FFCRU.INTERVAL_RULE interValRule, FFCRU.F_ACCR_END_DATE fAccrEndDate, FFCRU.ACCR_TDAY_RULE accrTdayRule, FFCRU.E_ACCR_DATE eAccrDate, FIN_CASH_INFO.FIRST_PAY_DATE firstPayDate, FIN_CASH_INFO.END_TDAY_RULE endTdayRule, FIN_CASH_INFO.PAY_TDAY_RULE payTdayRule, FIN_CASH_INFO.PAY_CYCLE payCycle, FIN_CASH_INFO.prod_style prodStyle, FIN_CASH_INFO.TERM_MAX investmentCycle, FP.vdate, FP.FINPROD_ID finprodid, FBRI.RATE_TYPE rateType, FBRI.RATE*100 rate, FBRI.COEFFICIENT coefficient, FBRI.INDEX_ID indexId, FBRI.INDEX_SOURCE indexSource, FBRI.SPREAD_RATE*100 spreadRate, FBRI.RESET_TYPE resetType, FBRI.REMARK remark from (SELECT FCI.CASH_ID, FCI.FINPROD_ID, FCI.FEE_ID, FCPR.FIRST_PAY_DATE, FCPR.END_TDAY_RULE, FCPR.PAY_TDAY_RULE, FCPR.PAY_CYCLE, PLP.PROD_STYLE, PLP.TERM_MAX FROM FIN_CASH_INFO FCI JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE FCPR ON FCI.CASH_ID = FCPR.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN PRD_LAYER_PARAM PLP ON FCI.FINPROD_ID = PLP.FINPROD_ID WHERE FCI.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} AND FCI.CASH_TYPE_2 = #{cashType2} AND (FCI.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} OR PLP.P_FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}) AND FCI.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}) FIN_CASH_INFO , FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE FFCR, FIN_FLOAT_COUNTING_RULE FFCRU, MST_FEEINFO MF, FIN_PRODUCT FP LEFT JOIN FIN_BASE_RULE_INFO FBRI ON FBRI.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID
AND FBRI.BASE_RULE_TYPE = #{baseRuleType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND FBRI.PUBLISH_TYPE = #{publishType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and FBRI.EFF_DATE = to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
where FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FFCR.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.CASH_ID = FFCRU.CASH_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FEE_ID = MF.FEE_ID and FIN_CASH_INFO.FINPROD_ID = FP.FINPROD_ID and FBRI.BRANCH = 0
and FFCR.EFF_DATE = to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') and FFCRU.EFF_DATE = to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
and (FFCR.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE AND FFCRU.EFF_DATE = FP.VDATE OR FP.FINPROD_TYPE2= #{finprodType2, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
select NVL(max(LEV), 0) from FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE_DETAIL where FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE_DETAIL.CASH_ID = #{cashId} and FIN_FLOAT_CALC_RULE_DETAIL.EFF_DATE = to_date(#{effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')
